params.name: roles
params.description: This parameter expects a comma-separated list of roleIDs to filter teams by

params.name: locations
params.description: This parameter expects a comma-separated list of locationIDs to filter roles by

params.name: name
params.description: This parameter is used to only get specific role by name. This parameter expects a string full name of a user or partial name with the wildcard %.

params.name: cursor
params.description: This parameter is a cursor that selects what teamID you want to start receiving results at. e.g. passing 137 here will only get you tasks with an id greater than 137.

params.name: limit
params.description: This parameter is a result limiter. The default is set to return no more than 100 results at one time.

items.docs: This request gets all of the Roles a User has and what Location they have that Role at.

This request returns a list of Roles.

This request creates a new Role. Roles are used for access management in Limble. Once a Role is created you can assign permissions to that Role via the web application and then assign Users to that Role to control what that User can do in Limble.

Parameter: name, Type: String, Required?: Required, Description: The name of the role.

params.name: roleID
params.description: The roleID of the role you are deleting
